question: _________ lead India at the Women’s Hockey Asia Cup 2022 in Muscat.
solution:
The Correct answer is **Savita Punia.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Savita Punia** captained the Indian team at the **Women’s Hockey Asia Cup 2022** held in **Muscat, Oman from January 21 to 28, 2022.**
 
• It was the **10th edition** of the Women's Hockey Asia Cup.
 
• Eight teams from Asia competed for the title: China, India (the defending champions), Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, Singapore, South Korea and Thailand.
 
• **Japan** emerged victorious, securing their **third title** by defeating **South Korea** in the final match.
 
• Regular skipper **Rani Rampal** missed out due to a hamstring injury, and defender **Deep Grace** **Ekka** served as the **vice-captain**.
 
• India competed against teams from China, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, Singapore, South Korea, and Thailand.
 
• The top four countries from the tournament qualified for the** Women’s Hockey World Cup 2022**, which was held in Spain and the Netherlands.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Top Scorer**: Cheon Eun-bi from South Korea scored a total of 7 goals during the tournament.
 
• **Best Player**: Yu Asai was recognized as the best player.
 
• **Best Young Player**: Salima Tete received the award for the best young player.
 
• **Best Goalkeeper**: Lee Jin-min was honored as the best goalkeeper.
